title: DA3408 A4 · CPU Image Captioning — Observability
description: Health → throughput → latency → errors → clients → system resources. Refresh 5 s.

options.content: **Is the service alive?** Up/down of the app and node exporter, model state and freshness. Text labels (UP/DOWN) carry the meaning, so colour is never the only signal.

panels.title: App status
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus can scrape the app's /metrics endpoint on :8000. 0 = app crashed or stopped.

panels.title: Node exporter status
panels.description: 1 = node_exporter on :9100 is reachable, so host metrics below are valid.

panels.title: Model
panels.description: 1 once the BLIP model is in memory. Set at first page load.

panels.title: App uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the app process started (process_start_time_seconds).

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: Seconds since any request last completed successfully. Large values with traffic = problem.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Browser sessions that interacted with the app in the last 5 minutes.

options.content: **How much work is flowing?** Images/s split by Single vs Bulk, request outcomes, and in-flight work. The dashed vertical markers are bulk ZIP uploads.

panels.title: Images captioned per second
panels.description: rate() of caption_images_processed_total{status="success"} over 1 min, by upload mode. Bulk jobs show as a sustained plateau; single uploads as short blips.

panels.title: Requests per second by outcome
panels.description: rate() of caption_requests_total over 1 min by mode and status. A bulk ZIP counts as one request.

panels.title: In-flight requests and bulk queue
panels.description: caption_active_requests (gauge) per mode, and caption_bulk_queue_remaining (images still waiting in the running ZIP).

panels.title: Upload volume
panels.description: rate() of caption_upload_bytes_total over 1 min by mode: how many bytes the app is ingesting.

options.content: **How fast is each image?** Percentiles from the histogram (log scale, so 0.5 s and 10 s are both readable), the full distribution as a heatmap, and where the time goes.

panels.title: Inference latency percentiles
panels.description: histogram_quantile() over caption_inference_seconds_bucket (1 min window). p50 = typical image, p99 = worst 1 %. Log₁₀ y-axis.

panels.title: Inference time distribution
panels.description: Per-bucket increase of caption_inference_seconds_bucket. Each column is one time step; brighter cells = more images finished in that latency band.

yAxis.axisLabel: Inference time bucket (s, bucket upper bound)

panels.title: Average time per stage
panels.description: Mean seconds per image for decode (Summary _sum/_count), preprocess and inference (Histogram _sum/_count). Inference dominates on CPU.

custom.axisLabel: Mean time per image (s, log₁₀ scale)

panels.title: End-to-end request duration
panels.description: Average of caption_request_duration_seconds (histogram) per mode. For bulk this is the whole ZIP; dotted line is caption_bulk_per_image_seconds (Summary).

options.content: **What is going wrong?** Failure rate, error types and files dropped from ZIPs, plus a sanity check on caption output.

panels.title: Errors per second by type
panels.description: rate() of caption_errors_total over 1 min by exception class. Dashed line (right axis) is the error ratio.

panels.title: Files skipped in ZIPs
panels.description: increase() of caption_files_skipped_total over 1 min by reason: non_image, hidden, corrupt, too_large, over_limit.

panels.title: Caption length
panels.description: Median and p90 of caption_length_words (histogram). A sudden drop to 1–2 words suggests bad inputs.

options.content: **Who is sending what?** Per-client volume from the client_ip label, and what kind of images arrive.

panels.title: Images per client (last 15 min)
panels.description: sum by (client_ip, mode) of increase(caption_images_processed_total[15m]). Uses the client_ip label.

panels.title: Requests per session (last 15 min)
panels.description: increase(caption_requests_total[15m]) by session label (first 8 chars of the Streamlit session id).

panels.title: Uploaded image size and tokens
panels.description: Median of caption_image_size_bytes (left axis) and tokens generated per second (right axis, dashed).

options.content: **Does the hardware explain the app?** Host CPU, memory, disk and load from node_exporter, overlaid with app throughput and the app's own memory. Bulk-upload markers line up spikes with their cause.

panels.title: Host CPU vs captioning throughput
panels.description: Left: node CPU utilisation % (100 − idle). Right, dashed: images/s across both modes. During a bulk ZIP both rise together.

panels.title: Host memory vs app memory
panels.description: Left: node memory used %. Right, dashed: resident memory of the app process (caption_process_rss_bytes). The model alone is ~1 GB.

panels.title: CPU time by mode
panels.description: rate(node_cpu_seconds_total[1m]) summed across cores by mode (user, system, iowait). Stacked, in cores busy.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: rate() of node_disk_read_bytes_total and node_disk_written_bytes_total. ZIP uploads and model load cause reads/writes.

panels.title: Load average and app CPU
panels.description: node_load1 and node_load5 (left) against the number of CPU cores; app process CPU % from psutil (right, dotted).

properties.value: App CPU (% of one core, linear)

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: rate() of node_network_receive/transmit_bytes_total excluding loopback. Includes browser uploads over the VM NAT.

panels.title: Root disk used
panels.description: node:disk_used:percent for /. Above 85 % turns orange, above 95 % vermilion.

panels.title: Swap used
panels.description: Swap in use on the VM. Non-zero during bulk jobs means the VM needs more RAM.
